theme.description: Inspired by high-end architectural IDEs and strategic command consoles. Uses deep obsidian slate, blueprint cyber cyan, glowing amber leverage accents, crisp structural grids, and monospace technical metadata.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-none text-slate-100 font-heading
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-100 font-heading

visual_enhancers.blueprint_mesh: background: linear-gradient(to right, rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.05) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.05) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: 32px 32px;

header.classes: fixed top-0 left-0 right-0 z-50 h-16 border-b border-slate-800/80 bg-[#070A0F]/80 backdrop-blur-xl px-4 sm:px-8 flex items-center justify-between
elements: Brand identity with glowing structural node icon + label 'EMERGENT // ARCHITECT'
Action CTA: '+ New Blueprint' with amber glow effect

bento_grid.container: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 p-6 sm:p-8

landing_page.hero: Dynamic structural wireframe header pitching 'Idea -> Scalable System Blueprint'
landing_page.features: Interactive 4-tier engine demonstration: Core Insight -> System Blueprint -> Leverage Points -> Production Assets
landing_page.interactive_demo: Live prompt sandbox preset triggers for rapid viewing
landing_page.cta: Primary CTA 'Build Your First System' navigating to auth or prompt input

auth.mode: Email/Password sign up & sign in tabbed workflow
auth.design: Tactical split screen with glowing wireframe node art on left, clean high-contrast form inputs on right

dashboard.title: Blueprint Vault / Systems Workbench
dashboard.grid: Grid of saved blueprints with metadata: Title, Core Insight summary snippet, creation timestamp, tech stack badges, leverage index score, quick actions (View, Rename, Delete, Export)
dashboard.controls: Search input, category filters (Fintech, SaaS, AI, Hardware, Consumer), New Blueprint button

inputs.idea_prompt: Multi-line rich tactical text field with prompt assistance & examples
inputs.constraints: Collapsible parameters: Industry context, Capital budget level, Target scale, Speed-to-market timeline

blueprint_generator_flow.generation_state: Streaming multi-stage terminal animation with node sequence visualization: Synthesizing Architecture -> Mapping Leverage Points -> Generating Schemas & Code Assets

sections: 1. Core Insight: High-impact strategic summary banner
2. System Blueprint: Architecture diagram, microservices topology, tech stack matrix, relational data models
3. Leverage Point: Tactical force-multiplier recommendation card with impact/effort score
4. Execution Roadmap: Phase 1-4 milestone timeline with deliverables
5. Risk Matrix & Mitigations: High/Medium/Low systemic vulnerabilities and solutions
6. Monetization Engine: Revenue model, pricing tier structure, unit economics
7. Executable Output: Syntax-highlighted production code, SQL/Prisma schemas, API specifications, and prompt stacks

accessibility_and_testing.apca_contrast: Ensure pure dark cards (#121A29) paired with #F8FAFC text for H1-H4 headings (ratio > 8.5:1). Neutral captions use #94A3B8 (ratio > 4.5:1).
accessibility_and_testing.reduced_motion: All dynamic grid animations and streaming generation states must honor prefers-reduced-motion CSS media query.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_data_testid: Mandatory requirement. Every primary action button, input field, modal trigger, export link, and card must include data-testid. Examples: data-testid='idea-prompt-input', data-testid='submit-blueprint-btn', data-testid='blueprint-card-{id}', data-testid='export-markdown-btn', data-testid='export-json-btn', data-testid='delete-blueprint-btn', data-testid='auth-tab-signup'.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a React JS (JavaScript) application located in /app/frontend/src.
Import Google Fonts 'Outfit', 'Plus Jakarta Sans', and 'JetBrains Mono' into index.html or index.css.
Set the document dark background to #070A0F and default text color to #F8FAFC in index.css.
Implement Lucide-React icons for technical UI indicators (e.g., Terminal, Cpu, Layers, Zap, Download, Share2, Trash2, Edit3, ShieldAlert, TrendingUp, Code2).
Use Sonner toast notifications (from src/components/ui/sonner) for user feedback on blueprint exports, copy events, and saving/deleting actions.
Ensure all interactive components have appropriate hover, focus, and active visual states with smooth transitions.
Ensure data-testid attributes are included across all user action components as mandated.
